_comment: Universal Python Bot Egg — works with ANY Python bot (WhatsApp/Telegram/Discord/Slack/IRC). Auto-detects entry file (main.py/bot.py/app.py/run.py/start.py). Installs requirements.txt / Pipfile / pyproject.toml.
name: Universal Python Bot
author: Caltex254
description: Universal egg for running ANY Python bot — WhatsApp (whatsapp-web.py, baileys-python wrappers), Telegram (python-telegram-bot, aiogram, telethon, pyrogram), Discord (discord.py, nextcord, py-cord), Slack (slack-bolt), IRC (botnet), or any other framework. Auto-detects the entry file (main.py, bot.py, app.py, run.py, start.py, src/main.py, src/bot.py). Auto-installs dependencies from requirements.txt, Pipfile, or pyproject.toml. Supports pipenv and poetry. Auto-restarts on crash with exponential backoff.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ ! -f universal-python-start.sh ]; then
    cat > universal-python-start.sh <<'STARTSH'
#!/bin/sh
echo '[install] Placeholder.'
STARTSH
fi
chmod +x universal-python-start.sh
echo '[install] Universal Python Bot egg ready.'

variables.name: Startup File (optional)
variables.description: Optional. Override the auto-detected entry file. E.g. 'src/main.py' or 'whatsapp_bot.py'. Leave blank to auto-detect.

variables.name: Max Restart Retries
variables.description: Number of times to auto-restart the bot on crash before giving up.

variables.name: Base Restart Delay (seconds)
variables.description: Initial delay between restart attempts. Doubles on each retry (exponential backoff), capped at 300s.

variables.name: Python Environment
variables.description: Optional. Set to 'development' to enable debug logging.
